name: Stephen
title: The First Martyr
summary: Stephen was one of the seven first deacons, full of faith, grace, and power. He performed great signs among the people and defended the faith so strongly that no one could stand against him. He became the first Christian martyr when he was stoned after a speech in which he accused the council of killing the Messiah.

keyEvents.title: Chosen as Deacon
keyEvents.description: Stephen was chosen as one of seven men to serve at the tables, full of the Spirit and wisdom.

keyEvents.title: The Debates
keyEvents.description: Stephen debated with Jews from several synagogues, and no one could resist his wisdom.

keyEvents.title: Speech Before the Council
keyEvents.description: Stephen delivered a long speech about Israel's history and accused them of resisting the Spirit.

keyEvents.title: The Stoning
keyEvents.description: Stephen was stoned while he prayed for his enemies, and Saul watched and agreed.
